_doc: FROZEN, mechanism-tagged discrete neighborhoods for the PSD2/AML regulatory-grounded policies (Experiment 2). Only PLAUSIBLE categorical binding confusions are registered as edges; arbitrary category swaps are NOT allowed. Every edge carries a `mechanism` and `allowed=true`. Frozen before the oracle runs. The numeric/continuous channel is the amount; these edges are the d=1 discrete moves N_1(s).

payment_channel.mechanism: channel binding ambiguity (POS vs CNP route mislabelled)

source_type.mechanism: instrument binding ambiguity (cash vs wire mis-typed)

excluded.aml_ctr.jurisdiction: EU/JP/other excluded — thresholds not source-locked (see aml_jurisdictional_thresholds.md); jurisdiction fixed at US.
excluded.note: No edge without a mechanism is allowed; non-adjacent swaps (e.g. tier_1<->tier_3) are intentionally NOT registered.
